name: Synthetic demo code corpus
origin: Generated locally by Cortexo scratch scripts
notes: Hand-authored toy Python/Java snippets so the tokenizer, cleanup and packing pipeline can be exercised offline and in CI without network access.

name: HumanEval
notes: Use only for evaluation. HumanEval terms require a data license set per OpenAI. Do not include solutions in the training corpus; keep solutions and tests in benchmarks/ only.

name: MBPP (Mostly Basic Python Problems)
notes: Evaluation only. Verify current license before any training use.

name: CodeSearchNet
notes: Candidate retrieval pretraining corpus. Each language has its own license; verify per sub-corpus.

name: SWE-bench-style task corpus
license: MIT for issue/patch fixtures (check origin repos)
origin: Derived from public bug-fix issue datasets
notes: Only the packaged issue text + target diff; code used under the originating repo license.

name: Permissively licensed small repositories
origin: Curated GitHub repos with explicit permissive licenses
notes: Record exact commit SHA and license for every repo before ingestion. Never assume 'all GitHub code is free for training'.

name: Cortexo PolyDB-SWE fixtures
notes: Synthetic enterprise database reasoning fixtures in PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle and Db2. Safe generated data.

name: Cortexo repository-understanding corpus
origin: Generated from synthetic internal example repositories (Cortexo itself + toy demos)
notes: Questions only reference facts from our own synthetic repositories.
